entities.name: Juan Ramón de la Fuente
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Ramón de la Fuente Ramírez is a Mexican psychiatrist, academician and politician who has served as the secretary of foreign affairs from 2024 until his resignation in 2026 during the presidency of Claudia Sheinbaum. He previously served as secretary of health in the cabinet of President Ernesto Zedillo (1994–1999) and as rector of the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM) from 1999 to 2007. He is a professor emeritus of Psychiatry at National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM) and chairs the foard of the Aspen Institute Mexico.
